messages:
sarah (support): FYI Acme tenant reported running a 3hr bulk-embed upload and then credits dropped to 0. They say midnight passed but API still returned 429s and the UI stayed at 0. Anyone seen this? :eyes:

devon (sre): Do we have the tenant id and a sample request id to trace?

sarah (support): Tenant: acme-inc (org_1234). Customer provided a root id: req_2026-03-15-08:12:44_org1234. They used the bulk embeddings endpoint with ~16 concurrent workers and retried failures. Attached a sample curl they used:

sarah (support): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Idempotency-Key: <they did NOT set one>" -d '{"input": [ ... ]}'
```

ingrid (eng): Quick question: does the bulk handler increment usage before the response is acked? If so, client retries could double/triple-charge. I'll check embed-worker logic and logs.

devon (sre): I pulled edge logs for req_2026-03-15-08:12:44_org1234: observed ~1.2M tokens of unique work in our processing traces but billing shows ~3.6M tokens for that window. Pattern looks like ~3x duplication. Client IP shows repeated retries at ~3s intervals hitting different edge nodes. No idempotency-key present.

ingrid (eng): I reproduced locally: launching 12 clients all uploading the same batch without an Idempotency-Key causes the billing counter to increment for each request. Filed ENG-5472 to add server-side duplicate suppression for bulk uploads.

sarah (support): Customer workaround question: can we advise them to pause until midnight refill? They said at 00:05 they still got 429s and UI was showing 0.

devon (sre): Traced the refill job: Refiller ran at 00:00 and DB shows balance restored. However a stale edge cache node had a 0 entry and TTL wasn't invalidated on refill. We invalidated edge for org_1234 manually and their API started accepting requests at 00:02. Adding an invalidate step to the refill workflow (OPS-219).

billing-bot: NOTE: Possible duplicate charges. Created billing ticket BILL-882 to investigate usage reconciliation and potential credit adjustments for org_1234.

ingrid (eng): Short-term recommendations for the customer: 1) Pause the bulk upload for now. 2) Use an Idempotency-Key per logical bulk job. 3) Limit to 4 concurrent workers while we deploy a fix. Long-term: server-side dedupe + automatic edge invalidation on refill.

sarah (support): I'll send these steps to the customer and request their upload logs + whether they used streaming vs chunked uploads. Will ask them to confirm if they add an Idempotency-Key and retry. Thanks all :pray:

devon (sre): Follow-up: ENG-5472 and OPS-219 opened. Ops will add the invalidate hook, Eng will add dedupe checks. Billing to reconcile. Reopen thread if customer still sees 429 after we've pushed fixes. :white_check_mark:
